'''Icefiends''' are monsters that may be encountered on the frozen floors while training [[Dungeoneering]]. Unlike normal Icefiends, these attack with both [[magic]] and [[ranged]], making them challenging foes if they are high-levelled. Their magic attack resembles a [[water blast]], and their ranged attack looks like four shards of ice. These monsters count towards an icefiend [[slayer task]].

Due to having a monster-specific drop, icefiends in Daemonheim can be classed as slayer monsters. However, they don't have a Slayer level requirement to be killed. Icefiends are the only Slayer Monster available to free-to-play during Dungeoneering. Despite this, their Slayer drops are members only.
